reasoning: 驗證目標：Seek Up 狀態的三種離開方式——找到電台後回到 Play、使用者取消後回到原始頻率、以及掃完整個波段兩輪仍未停台時於起始頻率停止。關鍵情境條件：波段內有可收聽電台對比全無可收聽電台；取消事件取自 CIP_Radio_Tables 的 SEEK Cancel_Stop Transitions 工作表（Cancel Seek 類）。為什麼這樣切：依 §7 三個分支各自為獨立的離開路徑，落點頻率互不相同（新電台 ／原始頻率／起始頻率），無法以一條 TC 同時驗證。刻意略過：哪些事件屬 Cancel 類、哪些屬 Stop 類由兄弟 leaf 006/007/008 覆蓋；本 leaf 只驗離開後的落點與播放狀態。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 005-01 搜尋成功，落點為找到的新電台；005-02 使用者取消，落點為原始頻率；005-03 兩輪掃完未停台，落點為起始頻率

assumptions: [A-AM10] CFTS024-4872387 (stop after two passes through the band) and CFTS024-4872391 (exit the Seek Up state on stopping or on returning to the starting frequency) are unallocated in the 037 and elaborate this leaf's exit conditions; absorbed and cited on 005-01 / 005-03.

tcs.tc_title: Seek Up exits to Play mode on the found station
tcs.test_item:
If the HU finds the Next Frequency it will exit the Seek Up state and return to Play mode. While the HU Tuner source is in the Seek Up state, the user may request to cancel the Seek Up state and the HU will return to the original Frequency and resume Play mode.

(Seek finds a station)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. At least one receivable station exists above the tuned frequency in the current wave band
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read and record the tuned frequency shown on the Radio Playing page
2. Press "Seek Up" on the Radio Playing page
3. Read the tuned frequency and listen to the audio output once the search ends
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed on the Radio Playing page
2. The HU enters the Seek Up state
3. The HU has left the Seek Up state, the Radio Playing page shows the found station, and that station is played

tcs.tc_title: Cancelled Seek Up returns to the original frequency
tcs.test_item:
If the HU finds the Next Frequency it will exit the Seek Up state and return to Play mode. While the HU Tuner source is in the Seek Up state, the user may request to cancel the Seek Up state and the HU will return to the original Frequency and resume Play mode.

(User cancels the Seek Up state)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. Receivable stations are far enough apart that the search runs long enough to be interrupted
tcs.input_test_data: Cancel Seek event: Steering Wheel Buttons Seek Up, listed as Cancel Seek in the SEEK Cancel_Stop Transitions worksheet
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read and record the tuned frequency shown on the Radio Playing page
2. Press "Seek Up" on the Radio Playing page
3. While the search is running, press the Steering Wheel Buttons "Seek Up" control
4. Read the tuned frequency and listen to the audio output
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed on the Radio Playing page
2. The HU enters the Seek Up state
3. The HU leaves the Seek Up state
4. The tuned frequency is the frequency recorded in step 1 and that station is played

tcs.tc_title: Seek Up stops at start frequency after two band passes
tcs.test_item:
If the HU finds the Next Frequency it will exit the Seek Up state and return to Play mode. While the HU Tuner source is in the Seek Up state, the user may request to cancel the Seek Up state and the HU will return to the original Frequency and resume Play mode.

(No station found after two passes through the band)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready and broadcasts no receivable station in the current wave band
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read and record the tuned frequency shown on the Radio Playing page
2. Press "Seek Up" on the Radio Playing page
3. Observe the frequency display until the search ends
4. Read the tuned frequency once the search ends
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed on the Radio Playing page
2. The HU enters the Seek Up state
3. The displayed frequency passes through the whole wave band twice and returns to the frequency recorded in step 1
4. The HU has left the Seek Up state and is tuned to the frequency recorded in step 1
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
